extract_minecraft_block_images: parse CSS and HTML chunk files to extract 32x32 Minecraft block images from a sprite sheet and pickle them
get_colors: analyze a 32x32 RGBA image and return a dictionary of detected color names with pixel counts
build_block_property_mappings: load block property data from JSON and build bidirectional name-to-property and property-to-name mappings
build_mob_property_mappings: load mob property data from JSON and build bidirectional name-to-property and property-to-name mappings
define_color_constants: use the COLORS numpy array, COLOR_NAMES list, and CMAP dictionary to map Minecraft block colors to normalized RGB values
